sources.quote:
This guy wanted to create a game but has no skills in digital art and sound design so he used gen ai to create icons and sfx. And you crying about a 5 euro game. Go pester activision when they use gen ai instead of hiring artists even though they have billions of dollars. One man dev teams can and should use AI to help with development. We need more indie games, not less
Emrecds View Profile View Posts [developer] Aug 27 @ 2:26pm Report this post Thank you so much for your valuable feedback. People sometimes lump independent two-person studios and billion-dollar companies into the same category, and that can be frustrating. On the art side, we’ve worked with freelance artists or done the work ourselves as much as our budget allowed. There’s almost no AI in the final version of the game, but we still chose to honestly state where we used it in development rather than be dishonest. #1
sepiz View Profile View Posts Aug 27 @ 2:44pm Report this post Originally posted by Emrecds : Thank you so much for your valuable feedback. People sometimes lump independent two-person studios and billion-dollar companies into the same category, and that can be frustrating. On the art side, we’ve worked with freelance artists or done the work ourselves as much as our budget allowed. There’s almost no AI in the final version of the game, but we still chose to honestly state where we used it in development rather than be dishonest. Of course. People need to remember that making games is hard and a 1 person or 2 person team won't be able to cover all aspects of development. AI is amazing for indie devs. I am also developing a game and AI let's me prototype a lot faster but of course my goal is to replace everything with hand-made assets in the end. Keep it up. #2
Legoyann View Profile View Posts Oct 7 @ 1:13pm Report this post Indie dev here, the problem is not using AI for making game, It's just that it greatly impact the quality of the game. If it was good a lot less people would complain. Also this game is just a quick cash grab with barely any replayability. #3
